attacks.name: Rapid Strike
attacks.notes: Multiattack Strength-based Strike 5; trades effect for accuracy

attacks.name: Speed Charge
attacks.notes: Move-by Action slam at full speed; alternate effect

powers.name: Speed Charge
powers.notes: Alternate effect of Rapid Strike; full-speed body slam

powers.name: Vibration Defense
powers.notes: Vibrating body partially phases through attacks; Toughness = Sta 3 + Protection 3 = 6

powers.name: Speed Dodge
powers.notes: Included in defenses; too fast to hit

specialAbilities.name: Defensive Trade-off
specialAbilities.description: Dodge 14 / Toughness 6: extremely hard to hit but less durable when struck.

specialAbilities.name: Offensive Trade-off
specialAbilities.description: Attack +14 / Effect 6 on Rapid Strike: hits often but each blow is individually weaker.

specialAbilities.name: Speed Tactics
specialAbilities.description: Prefers hit-and-run tactics. Uses Move-by Action to attack then retreat out of reach.
